cohort: 67 adolescent Syrian refugees and 188 adolescent Turkish locals who gave birth between January 2016 and July 2017 in Kocaeli Derince Training and Research Hospital Gynecology Clinic in Kocaeli, Turkey
finding: While there were no significant differences in most pregnancy outcomes between adolescent Syrian refugees and Turkish locals, Syrian refugees had shorter hospital stays and a higher, though not statistically significant, rate of low birth weight infants.
